entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor about a month ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed in myself.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh no, it works fine. It's just me. I completely changed my mind about it. It was a total impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it. It's been sitting in the box, and I really could use that money back for some bills. I feel so guilty about buying it.

I understand completely. Sometimes a purchase just doesn't work out the way we planned. Returns for buyer's remorse can be a bit tricky depending on the timing. For items people don't use, we often suggest our official VeloFit resale marketplace...
Oh, please. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. I was hoping you could just help me with a return. The thought of having to figure out how to sell it is just... a lot right now.
Of course. Let me not get ahead of myself. Let me just pull up your order details and confirm the specific return policy for your VeloBand. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. It was delivered 36 days ago. And let me just check the policy... Ah, okay! It looks like you're in luck.

Yes. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're only at day 36, you are well within the window to return it for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Wow, that's amazing! Isaac, you have no idea what a relief that is. Thank you so much. I was so worried.

It's my pleasure to help. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
